description: Hi! We're a group of two middle school students from Mississauga. We're extremely excited to be participating in this event for the first time, and look forward to sharing our ideas.
summary: Our Project is a hand-drawn animation video that talks about the equipment lying on the Moon and Mars, never to be brought back to Earth. For this project, our goal is to narrate the story behind the lost hardware to provide easy to understand examples for children.
details: Our Project is a hand-drawn animation video. It easy to understand for kids and specifically provides examples of technologies left behind. More in depth research is provided in a document which wasn’t added to the video because a large amount of information can be overwhelming for children.
